title: Ultimate AntiCrasher
description: It prevents all possible Minecraft crashes caused by server plugins.
body:
A client-side Minecraft mod that protects you from "crasher" servers — servers
that try to freeze or crash your game on purpose, usually to grief you or
troll you. It works quietly in the background: you won't see it doing
anything, you'll just notice your game *doesn't* crash when it normally
would.

Works with **Fabric and Quilt**, on every major Minecraft version from
**1.16.5 up to the current 26.2**.

[![Available for Fabric](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/513035d1231a86dff137c74e04a5e64633593f10.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/ultimate-anticrasher/versions?l=fabric)
[![Available for Quilt](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a9ee492fd1a5fcbcc14d4105aa27be63f2518529.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/ultimate-anticrasher/versions?l=quilt)

## What it protects you from

**Crash packets.** Some malicious servers send fake "explosion" or "particle
effect" messages with broken, absurd values (like an explosion happening a
billion blocks away, or a firework spawning thousands of particles at once).
A normal client tries to process this and freezes or crashes. This mod
recognizes when a packet like that is clearly not a real, normal explosion or
particle effect, and quietly throws it away before it can cause any trouble.
You'll never notice — actual explosions and actual particle effects always
look completely normal.

**Giant nametags.** Some servers try to crash you by giving a player or a mob
an absurdly long name — thousands of characters — hoping your game will choke
trying to draw it above their head. This mod caps any nametag at 64
characters; anything longer gets cut off with `...` at the end, so it's still
readable but can never be used to freeze your game.

**Advancement spam.** Some servers try to freeze you by granting and revoking
every advancement over and over in a tight loop, flooding you with rebuilds
and toast popups all at once. This mod holds those updates back while the
flood is happening and only lets them through once the server goes quiet for
a few seconds, so nothing is lost — it's just applied smoothly instead of all
at once.

That's it — the mod doesn't change how you play, doesn't add any items,
settings, or keybinds, and doesn't affect servers that behave normally.

No configuration needed — it just works.!
